AccessOps._comment: Route is set per process (one build, two entry points): --AccessOps:Route=Partner or --AccessOps:Route=Intranet. Both processes share DataRoot: the grants, hand-off handles, passkey challenges and credentials, the audit, the Data Protection key ring and the ingress switch file.

DataProtection._comment: One key ring and one application name for every node of AccessOps (both routes). Production: a shared, access-controlled path and ProtectKeysWith* (see docs/production-configuration.md).

Oidc._comment: No secret here: Oidc:ClientSecret comes from user secrets (Development) or the Oidc__ClientSecret environment variable. RequireHttpsMetadata is false only because the lab's test provider runs on http://localhost; keep it true for any real provider.

WebAuthn._comment: The relying party: the RP ID is the sign-in host (localhost for the lab), the origins are exact (scheme, host, port). WebAuthn.GetAsync sends no RP ID, so register and sign in on this same host.

Hosting._comment: Forwarded headers are honoured only from these proxies / networks (the ingress). Empty = from nobody.
